verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted SaaS API rather than an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis, and a probe finds an official MCP server documented in Jina's own GitHub org (jina-ai/MCP). The evidence is a single probe line with no detail on which Reader/Search capabilities it exposes or how to set it up. Missing for 10: documentation of the exposed tools and connection setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through it.
